entities.name: Bojana Drča
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bojana Drča is a Serbian professional volleyball player. She plays for the Serbia women's national volleyball team and Fenerbahce S.K. She was part of the Serbian team that competed at the 2012 Summer Olympics and won silver medal at the 2016 Olympics. She has won gold with the national team at the 2018 World Championship, the 2022 World Championship and the 2017 European Championship.
